title: 32 km inversion, 30 L-BFGS-B iterations under scpc_gamg with one paused solver on 4 ranks: does the remaining RSS growth scale with the local problem
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0 (one annotated solve at full n an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; alone on the machine (no other session's process in a 10 s CPU log)
resources: 4 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 1125 MiB after the first taped solve, 1355 MiB after the last (7.4 MiB a rank an evaluation, twice the 8-rank 3.8: the same total); peak 1978 MiB
cost: 232 s for 30 iterations (32 evaluations): 6.60 s an evaluation (median after the first)
audit: the same 30 iterations and 32 evaluations as the 8-rank run, objectives within 1.3e-7 of it (the partition), 74.5 V-cycles a condensed solve
notes: run under the probe wrapper of test-32km-inversion-reuse-lbfgs-before
